summary: Gerdau S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing two items: a Notice to Shareholders regarding the payment of dividends (R$0.18 per common and preferred share for Gerdau S.A.) and a Material Fact announcing the cancellation of 225,000 common shares and 7,380,000 preferred shares with no reduction in capital. These are routine corporate actions—ordinary dividend distribution and share cancellation—that do not constitute a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is present. This is an ordinary current report filed by a foreign private issuer.
